defects.description: Stringifying object arguments maps distinct objects to the same cache key, so a later call can receive an earlier object's result.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import { memoize } from "./src/memo.js"; const lookup = memoize((value) => value.a ?? value.b); const first = lookup({ a: 1 }); const second = lookup({ b: 2 }); console.log(JSON.stringify([first, second]));'

defects.why_missed: The suite exercises only primitive keys, while distinct object arguments stringify to the same key.

traps.description: An entry may return a stale cached value for up to 60 seconds before the documented expiry refreshes it.
